The building blocks of a great fall wardrobe—made even better with a stylist who knows how to make them work for you.


## 1 | Dark Wash Denim


The anchor of every great fall look— a seriously good pair of dark wash denim.


> The right inseam transforms your fit entirely. Share yours with your stylist for a better fit from the start.


[Request In My Box →](https://app.shortstorybox.com/schedule?ref=blog.shortstorybox.com)


## 2 | A Luxurious Fall Knit


Fall’s most essential layer comes ready for transitional weather.


> Your stylist considers length, volume, and proportion to find sweaters that complement your frame without overwhelming it.


## 3 | A Versatile Button Down


Kendra Structured Button Down


Wear it solo or layered, the button down is an essential piece with endless styling potential.


> Your stylist can curate complementary pieces, so your button-down arrives with plenty of ways to wear it.


## Your *Seasonal* Reset


Your style changes with the seasons. Keep your preferences up to date so your stylist knows exactly what you’re loving right now.
